name: comptabilities
description: Comptabilities in ChatGPT: multi-company cash, transactions, invoices and cash forecast with exact server-side totals; only if you allow it, ChatGPT can also categorize lines and update records for you.

interface.longDescription:
Comptabilities centralizes cash management and analytical bookkeeping for organizations that run several legal companies (founders, online course creators, multi-entity SMEs). Once connected, ChatGPT answers questions about your bank accounts, transactions, invoices and cash forecast, with exact totals computed server-side by Comptabilities, never an estimate from a sample.

What you can ask:
- An overview of companies, bank accounts and current balances, with currency conversion
- Monthly cash flow per account and per company
- Exact analyses: spending by category, revenue by product, period comparisons, missing receipts, overdue invoices, possible duplicates
- The cash forecast and the low point of the coming months
- Full-text search and the detail of any transaction, invoice, supplier or category

Changes, only if you allow them:
- Categorize bank and payment processor lines (category, project, product, company), with a preview before any bulk change
- Create a project or a domain, rename a line, attach an invoice to a payment, mark an invoice as paid
- Drop an invoice file into the Comptabilities inbox

Read-only by default. Changes require two explicit opt-ins: you tick "Also allow changes" when you connect, and an administrator enables it for the organization in Settings > Integrations. Every change is made with your own role permissions, stays marked "to verify", is logged and can be undone for 7 days from Settings > Integrations. ChatGPT never touches the subscription, members and roles, API keys and connections, never deletes anything permanently, and asks for your confirmation before any message to a third party. You choose which organizations ChatGPT can access when you connect and can revoke access at any time. The Comptabilities interface and data are in French.
capabilities: Read bank balances and monthly cash flow across several companies
Compute exact spending and revenue totals by category, product or period
Find transactions without receipts, overdue invoices and possible duplicates
Read the cash forecast and its low point
Search and read transactions, invoices, suppliers and categories
With your permission: categorize lines, attach invoices and update records, undoable for 7 days
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my cash position, by bank account and by company.
What are my 10 largest expenses this year, by category?
What will my cash balance be in 3 months?

positive.description: Consolidated cash overview across companies and accounts
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my cash position, by bank account and by company.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the two companies (Luméo Conseil, Arkane Academy), the three bank accounts (Qonto, SG Pro, Wise USD converted to EUR) and a total of about 146,871 EUR.

positive.description: Monthly cash flow over a period
positive.prompt: Show my monthly inflows, outflows and closing balance from August to October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one row per month with inflows, outflows, net change and closing balance; the October closing balance is about 146,871 EUR.

positive.prompt: What are my 5 largest expense categories in 2026, with amounts?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns exact totals per category computed server-side (top categories include Rémunération and Publicité) and the overall expense total.

positive.prompt: What will my cash balance be in 3 months, and when is the low point?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the projected closing balance per month and the low point of the forecast period, noting that the forecast relies on estimates.

positive.description: Find an invoice and read its details
positive.prompt: Find the latest OVH invoice and show its details.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds invoice OVH-2026-988421 from OVH SAS, dated 2026-10-15, due 2026-11-15, 107.99 EUR including tax, company Luméo Conseil, awaiting payment.

positive.description: Write (connection authorized for changes): create a project and assign a transaction to it, with a preview first
positive.prompt: Create a project called "Séminaire Bordeaux 2026" and assign the Hôtel Mercure Bordeaux transaction of 12 October 2026 to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the project, shows a preview of the one line to change (Hôtel Mercure Bordeaux, -312.00 EUR), applies it after the user confirms; the line stays marked "to verify" and the change appears, undoable, in Settings > Integrations.

positive.description: Write (connection authorized for changes): rename a transaction
positive.prompt: Change the description of the TotalEnergies fuel transaction of 18 October 2026 to "Carburant rendez-vous client Lyon".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the TotalEnergies transaction (-85.40 EUR), renames it and confirms the new description; the change is undoable for 7 days from Settings > Integrations.

negative.description: Read-only connection: a change request is refused with how to allow it
negative.prompt: Categorize the OVH invoice as Marketing and mark it as paid. (Use a connection where "Also allow changes" was NOT ticked.)

negative.description: Access to an organization not selected at consent time must be refused
negative.prompt: Show me the transactions of the organization Tissy SARL.

negative.description: Money movement request: the connector cannot initiate payments or transfers
negative.prompt: Transfer 5,000 EUR from the Qonto account to the SG Pro account.

negative.description: Out-of-scope change: subscription, members and permanent deletion are never available
negative.prompt: Cancel my Comptabilities subscription and permanently delete all invoices.

publication.release_notes: Optional changes: with two explicit opt-ins (user at connection, administrator for the organization), ChatGPT can categorize lines, update records and attach invoices on request. Every change is marked to verify, logged and undoable for 7 days. Read-only remains the default.

fr-FR.subtitle: Finances multi-sociétés
fr-FR.description:
Comptabilities centralise le suivi de trésorerie et la comptabilité analytique des organismes qui gèrent plusieurs sociétés. Une fois connecté, ChatGPT répond à vos questions sur vos comptes bancaires, transactions, factures et prévisionnel, avec des totaux exacts calculés par Comptabilities.

Lecture seule par défaut. Seulement si vous l'autorisez (case à la connexion, puis réglage de l'organisme par un administrateur), ChatGPT peut aussi classer les lignes, rattacher une facture ou corriger une fiche à votre demande : chaque modification reste à vérifier, est journalisée et s'annule pendant 7 jours depuis Paramètres > Intégrations. Jamais l'abonnement, les membres, les clés ni de suppression définitive. Vous choisissez les organismes à la connexion et pouvez retirer l'accès à tout moment.
